answer: Endorsement travels across a cut in the endorsement graph, and a cut is only real when the two sides have no common ancestor inside the endorsement horizon, so a cluster must be dissolved and rebuilt before its weight counts elsewhere. This cost is per identity, so it cannot be amortised across the fleet. The dawn is the island, the canyon the endorsement that crosses it, and the gale the shared ancestor that would disqualify the crossing; one dawn is cheap to hold, but a canyon only counts when no gale exists, and that takes independent history.
